idea-plugin.name: Local AI Agent
idea-plugin.description:
Native Codex CLI and Claude Code in IntelliJ IDEA. Continue the same project from a browser or phone.

Local AI Agent connects the current IDEA project directly to locally installed coding agents, including Codex CLI and Claude Code. It preserves the Agent's native sessions, tool loop, authentication, model settings, project instructions, MCP servers, permission prompts, planning, and follow-up questions inside IDEA. There is no second API key, login, model, or MCP setup to recreate.

Native Agent capabilities

  • Stream replies, reasoning status, commands, file edits, MCP calls, and subagent activity.
  • Resume native CLI sessions and project-scoped conversation history.
  • Choose the Agent, model, reasoning effort, Plan Mode, and execution permission level.
  • Detect, configure, install, update, and restart supported local Agent CLIs from IDEA.
  • See factual Agent activity in a quiet two-line status area and refresh available models without restarting IDEA.

One computer, multiple projects across IDEA, browser and phone

Connect the computer to Relay from the Remote access toolbar button. Projects on the same computer share one remote entry and can be opened individually without a separate MindFS installation. Scan the QR code or open the access link to connect automatically, without entering a pairing code. Enabled projects reconnect when opened in IDEA. Keep IDEA and the project running.

  • Messages and execution progress stay synchronized across connected clients in the same session.
  • Switch between shared projects while each project retains its own Agent backend and sessions.
  • Send instructions, answer questions and respond to approval requests remotely using the same Agent backend.
  • Browse project files, inspect changes and edit text files in the browser with revision-conflict detection.
  • Retry a failed connection with saved authorization. Manage individual projects or turn remote access off while continuing locally.

Remote business traffic is encrypted through Relay; connection metadata remains visible to Relay. Browsers retain pairing credentials and file/session caches. See the privacy policy for details.

Voice input that stays in your draft

Click the microphone in the composer, speak, then stop recording to insert the recognized text at the draft cursor. Recording never sends a message automatically. Configure Tencent Cloud, SiliconFlow, or a compatible custom speech service with your own credentials; each provider's credentials are stored separately in the IDE Password Safe.

  • Add selected code, the current file, or a project-tree file to the draft without sending it.
  • Send selected Run/Debug console output to a draft in the current or a new session for analysis.
  • Inspect turn diffs and open referenced project files in IDEA.
  • Follow the IDEA light or dark theme and switch between English and Chinese.

Local by default: the bundled service listens only on a random 127.0.0.1 port. Conversations and plugin settings stay on the local machine. Requests made by an Agent CLI follow that CLI's own configuration and provider terms. Optional voice input sends recorded audio directly to the speech provider selected by the user.

Requirements: IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1 or later with JCEF, plus at least one supported Agent CLI that is configured and signed in. Windows x64/ARM64 and macOS Apple Silicon/Intel are supported.

Resources: Documentation and source code · Report an issue · Privacy policy

中文

在熟悉的 IntelliJ IDEA 中使用原生 Codex CLI 和 Claude Code，也能通过浏览器和手机继续同一个项目。

Local AI Agent 将当前 IDEA 项目直接连接到本机安装的 Coding Agent，包括 Codex CLI 和 Claude Code。插件保留 Agent 原生的会话、工具循环、登录状态、 模型配置、项目指令、MCP、权限请求、Plan Mode 和追问交互，无需重复填写 API Key、 再次登录或重新配置模型与 MCP。

原生 Agent 能力

  • 实时展示回复、推理状态、命令执行、文件修改、MCP 调用和子 Agent 活动。
  • 恢复原生 CLI 会话，并按项目保存和继续历史对话。
  • 选择 Agent、模型、思考强度、Plan Mode 和执行权限。
  • 在 IDEA 内检测、配置、安装、更新和重启本机 Agent CLI。
  • 用安静的两行状态展示真实 Agent 活动，主动刷新可用模型，无需重启 IDEA。

一台电脑，多个项目，IDEA、浏览器和手机随时切换

通过工具栏“远程访问”连接 Relay，同一电脑上的项目共用一个远程入口，各项目可单独开放，无需另装 MindFS。 手机扫码或打开访问链接即可自动连接，无需输入配对码；已开启远程访问的项目随 IDEA 打开自动连接。 使用期间需要保持 IDEA 和对应项目运行。

  • 同一会话的消息和执行进度在三端实时同步。
  • 在开放的项目之间切换，各项目保留各自的 Agent 后台和会话。
  • 远程发送指令、回答追问和处理审批，沿用同一个 Agent 后台服务。
  • 在浏览器查看项目文件和代码差异，编辑文本文件时检测版本冲突。
  • 连接失败可重试，保留有效配对信息；关闭远程访问后，本地仍可继续使用。

远程业务流量经 Relay 加密转发，Relay 仍可见连接元数据。浏览器会保存配对凭据与文件/会话缓存，详见隐私说明。

不自动发送的语音输入

点击输入框麦克风开始录音，停止后将识别文字插入原光标位置，不会自动发送消息。可使用腾讯云、 硅基流动或兼容的自定义语音服务；填写自己的凭据后，各供应商凭据分别保存在 IDEA 密码保险箱。

  • 把选中代码、当前文件或项目树中的文件加入输入框，不会自动发送。
  • 将 Run/Debug 控制台选中的报错交给当前会话或新会话分析，先进入草稿，不自动发送。
  • 查看每轮文件差异，并在 IDEA 中直接打开回复引用的项目文件。
  • 跟随 IDEA 深色/浅色主题，界面支持简体中文和英文。

本机优先：插件内置服务仅监听随机的 127.0.0.1 端口；会话和插件设置 保存在本机。Agent CLI 发出的请求遵循该 CLI 自身的配置与服务条款。可选语音输入只会把 录音直接发送给用户选择的语音供应商。

运行要求：IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1 或更高版本并带有 JCEF；至少安装、配置并登录一个 受支持的 Agent CLI。支持 Windows x64/ARM64 和 macOS Apple Silicon/Intel。

相关链接： 使用文档与源代码 · 提交问题 · 隐私政策
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.26 — Shared remote project hub / 多项目统一远程入口

  • Share one computer connection across IDEA projects and switch between individually enabled projects from a browser or phone.
  • Connect by scanning a QR code or opening an access link, without entering a pairing code.
  • Manage project access separately and keep project sessions and Agent work on their existing backends.
  • Upgrade the shared remote entry automatically and restore registered projects while preserving its identity.
  • 多个 IDEA 项目共用一个电脑远程入口，可在浏览器和手机切换，按项目控制开放权限。
  • 扫码或打开访问链接自动连接，无需输入配对码；各项目继续使用原有会话和 Agent 后台。
  • 自动升级共享远程后台并恢复项目登记，保留电脑身份。

0.1.25 — Remote access / 三端远程访问

  • Adds a Remote access toolbar entry with Relay linking, shared IDEA/browser/phone sessions and live progress.
  • Pairs phones automatically from a QR code and reconnects enabled projects when IDEA opens, without opening the plugin panel.
  • Adds browser text editing with revision-conflict detection and drafts retained while navigating within the page.
  • Preserves valid pairing on connection failures and provides manual retry; fixes completion ordering between turns from multiple clients.
  • 新增远程访问入口与 Relay 绑定，IDEA、浏览器、手机共用会话并实时同步。
  • 手机扫码自动配对；已开启远程访问的项目随 IDEA 打开自动上线，无需打开插件面板。
  • 新增浏览器文件编辑、版本冲突检测与页面内草稿保留。
  • 修复网络失败误提示重新输码，提供保留配对信息的重试；修复多端轮次交接及完成状态回放。

0.1.24

  • Shows native Agent activity details in a quiet two-line status area with independent elapsed and last-update timers.
  • Adds Run/Debug console selection actions for analysis in the current or a new session, preserving drafts without automatically sending.
  • Adds manual Agent/model discovery refresh without restarting IDEA.
  • Fixes desktop Enter/IME sending, stale waiting-for-answer status, and connection-loss feedback with manual recovery actions.
  • Migrates older task databases without losing existing data, including the missing template_snapshot_json column.
